# Attribution

The dependency sets in these fixture `package.json`/`composer.json` files are
derived from (not copied verbatim from) upstream i18n-ally's own
`examples/by-frameworks/*` sample projects, to stay faithful to what a real
project using each framework looks like:

- `vue/` ← `examples/by-frameworks/vue-i18n`
- `react-i18next/` ← `examples/by-frameworks/react-i18next`
- `next-intl/` ← `examples/by-frameworks/next-intl`
- `svelte/` ← `examples/by-frameworks/svelte`
- `transloco-angular/` ← `examples/by-frameworks/ngneat-transloco`
- `laravel/` ← `examples/by-frameworks/laravel`
- `non-i18n-project/` ← `examples/by-frameworks/non-i18n-project`

Source: https://github.com/lokalise/i18n-ally (MIT License). See `/NOTICE` at
the repo root for the full upstream license text.
